# Non-test Go files that carry Mac-only code (gt-a2uug4).
#
# Each line is: path<TAB>name<TAB>count<TAB>class<TAB>reason
#   name    a host-only tool (launchctl, cmux, osascript, diskutil) named in a
#           string literal, or darwin for a file that is macOS-only: a _darwin.go
#           name, or a build constraint that cannot be satisfied without the
#           darwin tag.
#   count   for a host tool, the number of string literals in the file that name
#           the tool; a literal that names it twice counts once. A file with more
#           literals fails; a count the file no longer reaches fails as stale, so
#           lower it. A darwin line carries 1: a file is macOS-only or it is not.
#   class   pending-deletion: the reason names the removal bead or the deletion
#           area that removes the use. portable-shim (darwin lines only): the
#           Mac's own gt still runs the file; the reason names its exit bead.
#   reason  a darwin line names a bead id (gt-xxxx or gt-xxxx.N).
#
# The rule: no macOS-only code in gt. Every listed file is pending deletion, or a
# portable shim that stays until its exit bead, so the list only shrinks.
#
# The list is a ratchet. TestRepoHostTools fails on a host-tool literal this file
# does not allow; TestRepoDarwinFiles fails on a macOS-only file it does not list
# and on a darwin line that names no bead id. Both fail on a stale line: delete a
# line whose file no longer carries the use or the constraint, and lower a count
# the file no longer reaches. Do not add a line for new code: macOS-only code
# lives in devops gt-mac-watch, not in gt.
internal/cmd/process_start_darwin.go	darwin	1	portable-shim	gt-a2uug4.23: the capacity scan's process start token reads sysctl; deleted after the gt-wrap cutover
internal/config/daemon_steps.go	launchctl	2	pending-deletion	remaining launchd references: the rebuild_gt and update step descriptions name launchctl
internal/daemon/pressure_darwin.go	darwin	1	portable-shim	gt-a2uug4.23: the daemon's load average reads sysctl; deleted after the gt-wrap cutover
internal/hoststat/top_darwin.go	darwin	1	portable-shim	gt-a2uug4.23: the host CPU sample runs macOS top; deleted after the gt-wrap cutover
internal/polecatimage/stat_darwin.go	darwin	1	portable-shim	gt-a2uug4.23: the image cache reads atime through Stat_t; deleted after the gt-wrap cutover
internal/procid/start_darwin.go	darwin	1	portable-shim	gt-a2uug4.23: StartToken reads kinfo_proc through sysctl; deleted after the gt-wrap cutover
internal/templates/supervisor_state.go	launchctl	1	pending-deletion	remaining launchd references: the supervisor state reads the launchd job for gt daemon status and gt doctor
